name: P I Industries Ltd
about: PI Industries Ltd is a leading player in the agro-chemicals space having strong presence in both Domestic and Export markets. It has state-of-art facilities in Gujarat having integrated process development teams with in-house engineering capabilities. [1]

rows.promise: On track to commercialize 8 to 10 new molecules with 5 molecules already commercialized [Feb 2026].
rows.evidence: In Feb 2026, the company guided to commercialize 8 to 10 new molecules in FY26 [Feb 2026].

rows.promise: Expect sequential improvement and volume growth in Q4 FY26 over Q3 FY26 [Feb 2026].
rows.evidence: Management expected sequential revenue and volume growth starting Q4 FY26 over Q3 FY26 [Feb 2026].

rows.promise: Expect domestic and export growth to resume in FY27, led by recovery in exports in the second half [Feb 2026].
rows.evidence: First stated in Feb 2026 [Feb 2026] and reiterated in May 2026 [May 2026] and Aug 2026 [Aug 2026] that FY27 performance will improve led by export recovery in H2.

rows.promise: Expect FY27 and thereafter ETR to inch up to around 24% [May 2026].
rows.evidence: Management guided in May 2026 [May 2026] and reiterated in Aug 2026 [Aug 2026] that ETR for FY27 will be around 24%.

rows.promise: Expecting to bring another two to three chemical and biological molecules in the global arena in the next few years [Nov 2026].
rows.evidence: In Nov 2026 call, management expressed aspiration to launch 2 to 3 new molecules globally over the next few years [Nov 2026].

pushback: Saurabh Jain asked whether the growth expected in the fourth quarter is sequential only or Y-o-Y, and whether it refers to volume, revenue, or value growth.
Saurabh Jain pressed on whether volume growth in Q4 is also a year-on-year volume growth.
Saurabh Jain asked if revenue growth is expected to return in FY27 and whether it will be gradual or in a big way.
Saurabh Jain questioned whether customer visibility drives the FY27 recovery optimism or internal optimism.
Saurabh Jain asked for guidance on a sustainable gross margin percentage.
Saurabh Jain questioned the capex incurred over the last three years translating to almost INR 2,600 crore without seeing proportional results.
Ankur Periwal asked for a breakdown of the 90 molecules in the new molecule pipeline across Agchem, Electronic, Pharma, and Biologicals.
Ankur Periwal questioned whether the planned launch of four to five molecules in FY27 is across Agchem only or includes Electronic Chemicals and other products.
Ankur Periwal asked whether pricing pressure in Q1 was product-specific or a general trend across products.
snapshot: P I Industries Ltd is an agrochemicals and custom synthesis company operating across Agchem, Electronic Chemicals, Pharma, and Biologicals [Feb 2026 call]. Its revenue model is distributed across domestic sales and global exports through custom manufacturing and molecule commercialization [Feb 2026 call].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management expected sequential revenue and volume improvement in Q4 FY26 over Q3 FY26 [Feb 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q4 FY26 sales increased sequentially to INR 1,565.0 crore from INR 1,376.0 crore in Q3 FY26, although YoY sales remained negative at -12.4% [Feb 2026 call, Mar 2026 quarterly].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management guided for export recovery in H2 FY27 and performance improvement [Feb 2026 call, Aug 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 FY27 sales fell -10.4% YoY and Q2 FY27 sales fell -9.1% YoY, with Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin contracting sharply to 13.7% [Jun 2026 quarterly, Sep 2026 quarterly].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management stressed ongoing new molecule commercialization and global expansion [Feb 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Working capital lengthened in FY26 with cash conversion cycle stretching to 119 days from 42 days in FY25, while ROCE fell to 15.0% [FY26 working capital].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Operational cash generation supports corporate execution and investments [FY22–FY26 cash].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Operating cash flow dropped to INR 474.0 crore in FY26 from INR 1,413.0 crore in FY25, lowering CFO/PAT conversion to 36% [FY26 cash].

bull: Strong balance sheet health with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.03 and debt of INR 300.0 crore [Sep 2026 balance sheet].
Delivered historical growth with FY22–FY26 EBITDA CAGR of 10.9% and PAT CAGR of 11.9% [FY22–FY26 trajectory].
Management targets export recovery in H2 FY27 alongside ongoing commercialization of new molecules [Feb 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].
bear: Recent revenue contraction with Q2 FY27 sales down -9.1% YoY and EBITDA margins dropping to 13.7% [Sep 2026 quarterly].
Cash flow from operations declined to INR 474.0 crore in FY26, pushing CFO/PAT down to 36% [FY26 cash].
Working capital cycle stretched to 119 days in FY26 while ROCE declined from 23.0% to 15.0% [FY26 working capital].
watch: Quarterly EBITDA margin recovery from the Sep 2026 low of 13.7% back toward historical 25%+ levels [Sep 2026 quarterly, FY26 trajectory].
YoY sales growth trajectory turning positive after declining -9.1% in Sep 2026 [Sep 2026 quarterly].
Improvement in CFO to PAT conversion ratio from FY26's 36% toward the cumulative historical level of 88% [FY26 cash].
